mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status NOT IN (5, 6) AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayBorrowCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM return_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status NOT IN (2, 3) AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayReturnCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_in_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status NOT IN (4, 5) AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayStockInCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.equipment_id) FROM equipment_stock s JOIN equipment e ON e.id = s.equipment_id AND e.del_flag = 0 WHERE s.quantity <= COALESCE(e.safe_stock, 0)) AS warningStockCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrap_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = 0) AS pendingScrapCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment WHERE del_flag = 0) AS equipmentTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity * e.purchase_price), 0) FROM equipment_stock s JOIN equipment e ON e.id = s.equipment_id AND e.del_flag = 0 WHERE e.purchase_price IS NOT NULL) AS stockTotalValue

SELECT COALESCE(c.category_name, '未分类') AS categoryName, SUM(s.quantity) AS quantity FROM equipment_stock s JOIN equipment e ON e.id = s.equipment_id AND e.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_category c ON c.id = e.category_id GROUP BY e.category_id, c.category_name HAVING SUM(s.quantity) > 0 ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, SUM(s.quantity) AS quantity FROM equipment_stock s JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name HAVING SUM(s.quantity) > 0 ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.issue_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(bi.issued_quantity) AS quantity FROM borrow_item bi JOIN borrow_order b ON b.id = bi.borrow_id AND b.del_flag = 0 AND b.status IN (2, 3, 4) WHERE bi.issued_quantity > 0 AND b.issue_time IS NOT NULL AND (#{startDate} IS NULL OR DATE(b.issue_time) >= #{startDate}) AND (#{endDate} IS NULL OR DATE(b.issue_time) <= #{endDate}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(b.issue_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.confirm_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(ri.quantity) AS quantity FROM return_item ri JOIN return_order r ON r.id = ri.return_id AND r.del_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE r.confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND (#{startDate} IS NULL OR DATE(r.confirm_time) >= #{startDate}) AND (#{endDate} IS NULL OR DATE(r.confirm_time) <= #{endDate}) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.confirm_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT e.equipment_code AS equipmentCode, e.equipment_name AS equipmentName, c.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT bi.id) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_item bi JOIN borrow_order b ON b.id = bi.borrow_id AND b.del_flag = 0 AND b.status IN (2, 3, 4) JOIN equipment e ON e.id = bi.equipment_id AND e.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE bi.issued_quantity > 0 AND b.issue_time IS NOT NULL AND (#{startDate} IS NULL OR DATE(b.issue_time) >= #{startDate}) AND (#{endDate} IS NULL OR DATE(b.issue_time) <= #{endDate}) GROUP BY e.id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, c.category_name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未知部门') AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS borrowCount, SUM(bi.issued_quantity) AS borrowQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN bi.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN bi.issued_quantity - bi.returned_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outstandingQuantity FROM borrow_item bi JOIN borrow_order b ON b.id = bi.borrow_id AND b.del_flag = 0 AND b.status IN (2, 3, 4) LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = b.dept_id WHERE bi.issued_quantity > 0 AND b.issue_time IS NOT NULL AND (#{startDate} IS NULL OR DATE(b.issue_time) >= #{startDate}) AND (#{endDate} IS NULL OR DATE(b.issue_time) <= #{endDate}) GROUP BY b.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY borrowCount DESC, borrowQuantity DESC

SELECT r.order_no AS returnOrderNo, b.order_no AS borrowOrderNo, e.equipment_code AS equipmentCode, e.equipment_name AS equipmentName, ri.quantity AS quantity, ri.overdue_days AS overdueDays, ri.penalty_amount AS penaltyAmount, r.confirm_time AS confirmTime FROM return_item ri JOIN return_order r ON r.id = ri.return_id AND r.del_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1 JOIN borrow_order b ON b.id = r.borrow_order_id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.id = ri.equipment_id WHERE ri.is_overdue = 1 AND ri.overdue_days > 0 AND (#{startDate} IS NULL OR DATE(r.confirm_time) >= #{startDate}) AND (#{endDate} IS NULL OR DATE(r.confirm_time) <= #{endDate}) ORDER BY r.confirm_time DESC, ri.id DESC
